    Setup Community

    The Setup community collection of pages covers how to CRUD manage users of an xspatula project: organisations and users fill in an Excel spreadsheet, an admin reviews and curates it, and a notebook translates and inserts the accepted rows through the normal generic Excel-intake pipeline already used elsewhere in this site for adding user data, reused here as-is.

    Prerequisite

    setup_db.ipynb and setup_processes.ipynb must already have been run — including registering manage_organisation and manage_user the same way any process is registered (see Define and register a process; the two registration files for this collection’s example are setup/zzz/xspatula/setup_processes/json_xspatula/community/organisation_v10_sql.json and user_v10_sql.json) — before anything in this collection works. The registration notebook covered here logs in as a real community.user to perform its inserts, so a working login (see Bootstrap user) has to exist first.

    Pages in this collection

    1. Bootstrap user — the chicken-and-egg problem: the very first user can’t be created through the Excel flow, since that flow requires an already-logged-in user
    2. SMTP email — the outgoing-email setup new users’ passwords are delivered through
    3. Excel intake — the two spreadsheets, organisation.xlsx and user.xlsx, and their columns
    4. Register notebook — the admin’s review-and-run workflow
    5. Welcome email — what a newly registered user actually receives

    Input files

    File Purpose
    organisation/excel/organisation.xlsx Source spreadsheet; one row per organisation submitted for registration
    user/excel/user.xlsx Source spreadsheet; one row per user submitted for registration — no password column
    organisation/job_translate_organisation.json Job file for translating organisation.xlsx
    organisation/translate_organisation.txt Pilot file for the organisation translate step
    user/job_translate_user.json Job file for translating user.xlsx
    user/translate_user.txt Pilot file for the user translate step
    organisation/manage_process/manage_organisation.json Generated by the translate step; inserted by register_users.ipynb
    user/manage_process/manage_user.json Generated by the translate step, then password-populated by Provision_user_passwords before insert
    src/postgres/environment/.xspatula_email.env Gitignored SMTP credentials used to send welcome emails
